title: prompt-library-scratchpad-noah-williams
content:
Quick notes / brain dump (working)

- Goal: consolidate high-utility prompt templates and small few-shot banks for the internal prompt library. Focus on extraction, classification, and concise summarization tasks we see in customer support and docs ingestion flows.
- Keep templates short, robust to model/temperature changes; label failure modes explicitly and include a fallback/verification step where useful.

Current templates to iterate on

1) Action-item extraction (3-shot template)
Prompt:
  'Extract action items from the meeting note. Return a JSON list of items with fields: assignee (if any), action, due (if mentioned, else null), context_snippet.'
Few-shot examples (3):
  EX1 input: 'We should ping infra about the DB migration. Alex to take lead. Aim for next Wednesday.'
  EX1 output: [{assignee: 'Alex', action: 'ping infra about DB migration', due: 'next Wednesday', context_snippet: 'Aim for next Wednesday.'}]

  EX2 input: 'Follow up with legal on contract language; no owner assigned yet.'
  EX2 output: [{assignee: null, action: 'follow up with legal on contract language', due: null, context_snippet: 'no owner assigned yet.'}]

  EX3 input: 'QA to run smoke tests after the deploy; Sam will coordinate.'
  EX3 output: [{assignee: 'Sam', action: 'run smoke tests after the deploy', due: null, context_snippet: 'after the deploy; Sam will coordinate.'}]

Notes: keep examples varied (names, no-owner, due-dates relative). Model often over-generates extra fields (status, priority) — explicitly instruct to NOT invent additional fields.

2) Tone rewrite (customer-facing) - few-shot
Prompt: 'Rewrite the following message to be concise and professional for a customer-facing email. Preserve core facts.'
Shots: 2 examples showing before/after. Use conservative edits only.

Failure-case patterns we've observed

- Hallucinated mentions: model invents people or tickets. Mitigation: include a verification step prompt: 'If a named person appears who is not in the source, respond: "UNKNOWN_PERSON" for assignee.'
- Token truncation: long meeting notes lose end-of-list items. Mitigation: detect length > 1200 tokens and return 'TRUNCATED' + summary of first/last 3 bullets.
- Instruction collapse: when template is too prescriptive, model copies examples instead of generalizing. Mitigation: vary examples (format, order) and add explicit generalization instruction: 'Do not repeat the examples; apply the pattern.'
- Overly terse outputs: for summaries we need 1-2 sentences; model sometimes returns 4-5 bullets. Add 'limit to 2 sentences' and a hard stop token instruction.

Failure-case concrete examples (for repro):
- Input: 'See notes: ... (long)'. Model output: invented ticket 'INF-999' referenced. Root cause: few-shot includes a sample with a ticket ID; model learned to inject IDs. Fix: sanitize examples to use placeholders like 'TICKET_ID'.
- Input: 'Assign task' -> Model returns a long narrative instead of structured JSON. Root cause: not enforcing JSON-only. Fix: 'Output must be valid JSON array only. If unsure, return []'.

Evaluation plan / metrics

- For extraction tasks: precision/recall against labeled set (N=500). Also measure exact-match on critical fields (assignee, action). Track false-positive hallucinations (invented names/tickets) as a separate rate.
- For rewrite/tone: human-rated 1-5 for professionalism + automatic length/clarity checks (Flesch-Kincaid optional).
- Regression tests: add 50 'known failure' prompts to the CI harness. Fail build if hallucination rate > 2% or JSON-validity < 99%.

Micro experiments to run (next week)

- A/B: 3-shot vs 5-shot for action-item extraction at temp=0.0/0.2/0.6. Metrics: precision, hallucination rate.
- Prompt engineering: test explicit 'do not add fields' clause vs implicit. Measure number of extra fields.
- Fallbacks: chain-of-thought style verification prompt appended to encourage model to self-check before output.

Scratch TODOs

- [ ] Convert 3 best templates into canonical repo format (see linked GH PR)
- [ ] Create labeling guide for action items (examples of ambiguous cases)
- [ ] Add tests to CI harness (Jira INF-4210)
- [ ] Run batch eval on 500 historical meeting notes and capture baseline metrics

Links / references
- Confluence spec: DLX-982-prompt-library (link in metadata)
- GH PR with canonical schema: repo/redwood-prompts/pull/78

Notes to self:
- Keep a 'sanitization' pre-step for customer data: remove ticket IDs, emails before prompt if needed.
- When adding examples, prefer neutral placeholders (Person A) instead of real-looking names to reduce hallucination.

Unresolved questions
- Should we allow 'assignee: team' as valid value (e.g., 'SRE team')? For now allow strings; consider canonicalizing to user IDs in downstream pipeline.
- Best threshold for truncation handling? Start with 1200 tokens, iterate.

End of scratchpad.
